project: LLVM libc++, libc++abi, and libunwind headers

compiler_validation.distribution: local audit build; unpublished compiler fixes
compiler_validation.build_note: Isolated frontend and Z80 target archives linked with the existing Clang 22.1.8 build. The embedded version still reports ff0702aaaa7a; the audited source snapshots match the listed commits.

v23_target_adaptations: Exclude _BitInt abs overloads: the eZ80 target does not implement _BitInt despite advertising __BITINT_MAXWIDTH__.
Use exact integer year/month periods: int is 24 bits and double is 32 bits.
Keep algorithm SIMD utilities disabled: packed vector-boolean bitcasts fail in locale digit lookup and in O2 algorithm stress tests.
Use a native storage-word mask for small-bitset popcount instead of _BitInt.

compression_exceptions.reason: The raw program with all 108 direct comparison expressions exceeds one variable.

followup_notes: The obsolete __ishru_1_fast/__ishrs_1_fast aliases are removed; supported compiler builds use the original entry points.
Generic 24/48-bit byteswap, runtime math classification, integer parser overflow builtins, and the weak-function override detector now use upstream implementations.
The new compiler fixes are not yet published. The c1c359f0f2ea nightly alone is insufficient for this branch.
The published compiler nightly already includes the 48-bit signedness and bidirectional floating-point conversion fixes.

int48_extension_validation.math_promotion: compile-time return types and runtime mixed signed/unsigned 48-bit hypot
int48_extension_validation.floating_point_conversions: runtime casts in both directions for signed/unsigned 48-bit integers and float/double/long double, including boundaries and truncation toward zero

required_compiler_fixes.description: Correct 48-bit signedness transformations, including enums and cv qualifiers.
Legalize integer/floating-point conversions in both directions for 48-bit integers.
Model comparison pseudo inputs correctly for machine verification.
Clang: lower odd-byte native byteswap through an even-width intrinsic
Z80: accept immediate symbol operands with the inline asm X constraint
Z80: preserve live inputs and kill flags during copy expansion
Z80: respect NaNs and signed zeros in floating-point comparisons
Z80: legalize partial-width comparison and overflow operands

compiler_audit_validation.clang_byteswap_checks: CodeGen in Z80/eZ80 modes and both constant evaluators; existing builtin-bswapg Sema tests also pass
compiler_audit_validation.runtime_compiler: local build with the optimization series

floating_point_comparisons.reference: integer ranks and explicit NaN indices

compiler_audit_validation.bitset_checks: constexpr set/flip/count and runtime per-bit reference
compiler_audit_validation.algorithm_checks: find/count/equal/mismatch with every mismatch offset, at Oz and O2; SIMD exclusion retained
compiler_audit_validation.override_detection: separately compiled weak definitions, strong replacement of one hook, default hook unchanged
